notes: F-VQ10 qualifies only the method and machine-readable promotion boundary for a future temporal profile; it supplies no physical temporal limits.
Calibration and validation observation sets must be disjoint, and a candidate profile must be frozen before validation.
Validation data may not be used to retune limits without invalidating that validation evidence.
Solver-convergence and hard mass-balance tolerances are forbidden as substitutes for temporal-accuracy limits.
Hard mass conservation remains a separate absolute gate for every admitted observation and execution path.
